عاماً من الخبرة

تمتلك مجموعة المهيدب، بصفتها واحدة من أكبر المجموعات الاستثمارية في الشرق الأوسط، عدداً من الاستثمارات
في الشركات على امتداد القطاعين العام والخاص في المملكة العربية السعودية وحول العالم، وينصبّ تركيزنا
الأساسي في المجموعة على قطاعات الأغذية والمواد الاستهلاكية، و الصناعة والبنية التحتية، والعقارات،
والاستثمار المالي، كما نملك بعض الاستثمارات ضمن قطاعات أخرى نؤمن أنها ستشكل إضافة قيّمة لعملائنا
ومساهمينا وجميع المعنيين وأصحاب العلاقة.

### الأغذية والمواد الاستهلاكية

انطلقت المجموعة في قطاع الأغذية والمواد الاستهلاكية منذ أكثر من ثمانية عقود، وتطوّرت لتصبح اليوم من
الجهات الرائدة ذات الحضور الواسع في السوق السعودي والأسواق الإقليمية. وتقدّم المجموعة محفظة متنوّعة من
المنتجات التي تلبّي احتياجات المستهلكين، مع التزام مستمر بالجودة وبناء شراكات طويلة الأمد.

][38]
[

### الصناعة والبنية التحتية

يضمّ قطاع الصناعة والبنية التحتية في مجموعة المهيدب مجموعة متنوّعة من الشركات المتخصّصة في مجالات مواد
البناء والطاقة والمقاولات والخدمات والبنية التحتية. وتعزّز المجموعة حضورها عبر شراكات فاعلة مع القطاع
العام للإسهام في تلبية احتياجات المملكة، بما يتماشى مع مستهدفاتها في التنمية المستدامة وتعزيز كفاءة
الإدارة.

][39]
[

### التطوير العقاري

يقدّم القطاع العقاري في مجموعة المهيدب حلولًا عقارية متكاملة تشمل التطوير والمقاولات والتنفيذ الإنشائي.
وتعمل المجموعة على تطوير مشاريع سكنية وتجارية وصناعية متعددة الاستخدامات، تُسهم في دعم التنمية وتحقيق
أثر إيجابي ومستدام على المجتمع والاقتصاد، على المستويين المحلي والعالمي.

][40]

## فلسفتنا الاستثمارية

[AMG]

#### البحث المستمرعن الفرص الواعدة

نعمل في مجموعة المهيدب على بناء محافظ متنوعة من الاستثمارات وتحديداً في الأسواق والقطاعات التي نجدها
أكثر امتلاءً بالفرص وانفتاحاً على الجديد منها، فإلى جانب الاستثمار في الأعمال التي تكمّل محافظنا الحالية
وتزيد من مقدار القيمة المضافة للمساهمين وأصحاب المصلحة، نقوم كذلك باستكشاف مزيد من الفرص في الأسواق
الصاعدة والقطاعات الناشئة مثل قطاع الترفيه المزدهر في المملكة العربية السعودية. وباتبّاع هذه الفلسفة
الاستثمارية، تستمر المهيدب في توسعة نطاق أعمالها عبر 4 قارات و25 دولة في الوقت الحالي.

[اكتشف المزيد][41]
[AMG]

#### الاستثمار بمسؤولية

تضع المجموعة عوامل الحوكمة البيئية والاجتماعية وحوكمة الشركات (ESG) على رأس قائمة أولوياتها وذلك بهدف
تحقيق النموّ لأعمالنا بصورة تؤثّر إيجابياً في الأسواق والدوائر الاجتماعية التي نعمل على خدمتها على المدى
الطويل.

### الأغذية والمواد الاستهلاكية

انطلقت المجموعة في قطاع الأغذية والمواد الاستهلاكية منذ أكثر من ثمانية عقود، وتطوّرت لتصبح اليوم من
الجهات الرائدة ذات الحضور الواسع في السوق السعودي والأسواق الإقليمية. وتقدّم المجموعة محفظة متنوّعة من
المنتجات التي تلبّي احتياجات المستهلكين، مع التزام مستمر بالجودة وبناء شراكات طويلة الأمد.

][38]
[

### الصناعة والبنية التحتية

يضمّ قطاع الصناعة والبنية التحتية في مجموعة المهيدب مجموعة متنوّعة من الشركات المتخصّصة في مجالات مواد
البناء والطاقة والمقاولات والخدمات والبنية التحتية. وتعزّز المجموعة حضورها عبر شراكات فاعلة مع القطاع
العام للإسهام في تلبية احتياجات المملكة، بما يتماشى مع مستهدفاتها في التنمية المستدامة وتعزيز كفاءة
الإدارة.

][39]

### التطوير العقاري

يقدّم القطاع العقاري في مجموعة المهيدب حلولًا عقارية متكاملة تشمل التطوير والمقاولات والتنفيذ الإنشائي.
وتعمل المجموعة على تطوير مشاريع سكنية وتجارية وصناعية متعددة الاستخدامات، تُسهم في دعم التنمية وتحقيق
أثر إيجابي ومستدام على المجتمع والاقتصاد، على المستويين المحلي والعالمي.

## فلسفتنا الاستثمارية

[AMG]

#### البحث المستمرعن الفرص الواعدة

نعمل في مجموعة المهيدب على بناء محافظ متنوعة من الاستثمارات وتحديداً في الأسواق والقطاعات التي نجدها
أكثر امتلاءً بالفرص وانفتاحاً على الجديد منها، فإلى جانب الاستثمار في الأعمال التي تكمّل محافظنا الحالية
وتزيد من مقدار القيمة المضافة للمساهمين وأصحاب المصلحة، نقوم كذلك باستكشاف مزيد من الفرص في الأسواق
الصاعدة والقطاعات الناشئة مثل قطاع الترفيه المزدهر في المملكة العربية السعودية. وباتبّاع هذه الفلسفة
الاستثمارية، تستمر المهيدب في توسعة نطاق أعمالها عبر 4 قارات و25 دولة في الوقت الحالي.

[اكتشف المزيد][41]
[AMG]

#### الاستثمار بمسؤولية

تضع المجموعة عوامل الحوكمة البيئية والاجتماعية وحوكمة الشركات (ESG) على رأس قائمة أولوياتها وذلك بهدف
تحقيق النموّ لأعمالنا بصورة تؤثّر إيجابياً في الأسواق والدوائر الاجتماعية التي نعمل على خدمتها على المدى
الطويل.

# At the heart of healthcare

Mediq serves healthcare professionals and patients with medical devices, healthcare products and
innovative solutions. We work with hospitals, healthcare facilities, GPs and nurses to ensure that
they can provide best possible care. We also supply people with the daily support and care they need
to successfully self-manage their chronic condition. Both in health-care settings and at home.

### Our Vision

## Enabling Sustainable Healthcare

At Mediq, we are at the heart of healthcare, supporting delivery to patients' homes, practitioners,
care institutions, and hospitals. We offer products, solutions, and services across major disease
areas, driving innovative solutions to address healthcare’s biggest challenges.

Fueled by our dedicated team, we optimize time and resources, making care more manageable for
providers, efficient for payors, better for the environment, and ultimately better for patients and
society. We call that Sustainable Care.

[Read more about us][18]

[care to care]
Our ESG Efforts

## We Care to Care

At Mediq, responsible and ethical business practices are at the heart of everything we do, guiding
our actions towards patients, employees, partners, suppliers, and investors. Mediq’s ESG
(Environmental, Social, Governance) strategy is built on four key pillars: products, services,
operations, and people. Our goal is to achieve carbon neutrality and create a lasting positive
impact on our environment and communities by 2050.

[Explore our full ESG strategy here][19]

## Providing empowerment, support and care

A lot has happened since Mediq was founded in the Netherlands in 1899 as a cooperative of
pharmacists. Our drive to help patients live higher quality lives is what has made our company the
leading European healthcare provider it is today. To this end, we consistently invest in operational
excellence as well as advanced digital technologies and innovative care delivery models. Always
looking for new opportunities to make life and work easier and more enjoyable for people with
healthcare needs and those who care for them.

[Read more about Mediq][20]

#### Mediq launches Mediq Select: another step forward in enabling sustainable healthcare

Mediq offers a broad product portfolio, enabling healthcare professionals to choose what best fits
their needs—from trusted third-party brands to Mediq own-brand ranges. For years, our own brands,
including Klinion, Absorin, Curion and 365 Healthcare, have delivered a strong balance between high
quality standards and affordability.

To make this portfolio easier to navigate, Mediq is bringing these products together under a single
label: Mediq Select. While the products, specifications, and product codes remain unchanged, the new
label provides a clearer and more consistent way for healthcare professionals to identify solutions
they can trust.

عاماً من الخبرة

تمتلك مجموعة المهيدب، بصفتها واحدة من أكبر المجموعات الاستثمارية في الشرق الأوسط، عدداً من الاستثمارات
في الشركات على امتداد القطاعين العام والخاص في المملكة العربية السعودية وحول العالم، وينصبّ تركيزنا
الأساسي في المجموعة على قطاعات الأغذية والمواد الاستهلاكية، و الصناعة والبنية التحتية، والعقارات،
والاستثمار المالي، كما نملك بعض الاستثمارات ضمن قطاعات أخرى نؤمن أنها ستشكل إضافة قيّمة لعملائنا
ومساهمينا وجميع المعنيين وأصحاب العلاقة.

### الأغذية والمواد الاستهلاكية

انطلقت المجموعة في قطاع الأغذية والمواد الاستهلاكية منذ أكثر من ثمانية عقود، وتطوّرت لتصبح اليوم من
الجهات الرائدة ذات الحضور الواسع في السوق السعودي والأسواق الإقليمية. وتقدّم المجموعة محفظة متنوّعة من
المنتجات التي تلبّي احتياجات المستهلكين، مع التزام مستمر بالجودة وبناء شراكات طويلة الأمد.

][38]
[

### الصناعة والبنية التحتية

يضمّ قطاع الصناعة والبنية التحتية في مجموعة المهيدب مجموعة متنوّعة من الشركات المتخصّصة في مجالات مواد
البناء والطاقة والمقاولات والخدمات والبنية التحتية. وتعزّز المجموعة حضورها عبر شراكات فاعلة مع القطاع
العام للإسهام في تلبية احتياجات المملكة، بما يتماشى مع مستهدفاتها في التنمية المستدامة وتعزيز كفاءة
الإدارة.

][39]
[

### التطوير العقاري

يقدّم القطاع العقاري في مجموعة المهيدب حلولًا عقارية متكاملة تشمل التطوير والمقاولات والتنفيذ الإنشائي.
وتعمل المجموعة على تطوير مشاريع سكنية وتجارية وصناعية متعددة الاستخدامات، تُسهم في دعم التنمية وتحقيق
أثر إيجابي ومستدام على المجتمع والاقتصاد، على المستويين المحلي والعالمي.

][40]

## فلسفتنا الاستثمارية

[AMG]

#### البحث المستمرعن الفرص الواعدة

نعمل في مجموعة المهيدب على بناء محافظ متنوعة من الاستثمارات وتحديداً في الأسواق والقطاعات التي نجدها
أكثر امتلاءً بالفرص وانفتاحاً على الجديد منها، فإلى جانب الاستثمار في الأعمال التي تكمّل محافظنا الحالية
وتزيد من مقدار القيمة المضافة للمساهمين وأصحاب المصلحة، نقوم كذلك باستكشاف مزيد من الفرص في الأسواق
الصاعدة والقطاعات الناشئة مثل قطاع الترفيه المزدهر في المملكة العربية السعودية. وباتبّاع هذه الفلسفة
الاستثمارية، تستمر المهيدب في توسعة نطاق أعمالها عبر 4 قارات و25 دولة في الوقت الحالي.

[اكتشف المزيد][41]
[AMG]

#### الاستثمار بمسؤولية

تضع المجموعة عوامل الحوكمة البيئية والاجتماعية وحوكمة الشركات (ESG) على رأس قائمة أولوياتها وذلك بهدف
تحقيق النموّ لأعمالنا بصورة تؤثّر إيجابياً في الأسواق والدوائر الاجتماعية التي نعمل على خدمتها على المدى
الطويل.

### الأغذية والمواد الاستهلاكية

انطلقت المجموعة في قطاع الأغذية والمواد الاستهلاكية منذ أكثر من ثمانية عقود، وتطوّرت لتصبح اليوم من
الجهات الرائدة ذات الحضور الواسع في السوق السعودي والأسواق الإقليمية. وتقدّم المجموعة محفظة متنوّعة من
المنتجات التي تلبّي احتياجات المستهلكين، مع التزام مستمر بالجودة وبناء شراكات طويلة الأمد.

][38]
[

### الصناعة والبنية التحتية

يضمّ قطاع الصناعة والبنية التحتية في مجموعة المهيدب مجموعة متنوّعة من الشركات المتخصّصة في مجالات مواد
البناء والطاقة والمقاولات والخدمات والبنية التحتية. وتعزّز المجموعة حضورها عبر شراكات فاعلة مع القطاع
العام للإسهام في تلبية احتياجات المملكة، بما يتماشى مع مستهدفاتها في التنمية المستدامة وتعزيز كفاءة
الإدارة.

][39]
[

### التطوير العقاري

يقدّم القطاع العقاري في مجموعة المهيدب حلولًا عقارية متكاملة تشمل التطوير والمقاولات والتنفيذ الإنشائي.
وتعمل المجموعة على تطوير مشاريع سكنية وتجارية وصناعية متعددة الاستخدامات، تُسهم في دعم التنمية وتحقيق
أثر إيجابي ومستدام على المجتمع والاقتصاد، على المستويين المحلي والعالمي.

## فلسفتنا الاستثمارية

[AMG]

#### البحث المستمرعن الفرص الواعدة

نعمل في مجموعة المهيدب على بناء محافظ متنوعة من الاستثمارات وتحديداً في الأسواق والقطاعات التي نجدها
أكثر امتلاءً بالفرص وانفتاحاً على الجديد منها، فإلى جانب الاستثمار في الأعمال التي تكمّل محافظنا الحالية
وتزيد من مقدار القيمة المضافة للمساهمين وأصحاب المصلحة، نقوم كذلك باستكشاف مزيد من الفرص في الأسواق
الصاعدة والقطاعات الناشئة مثل قطاع الترفيه المزدهر في المملكة العربية السعودية. وباتبّاع هذه الفلسفة
الاستثمارية، تستمر المهيدب في توسعة نطاق أعمالها عبر 4 قارات و25 دولة في الوقت الحالي.

[اكتشف المزيد][41]
[AMG]

#### الاستثمار بمسؤولية

تضع المجموعة عوامل الحوكمة البيئية والاجتماعية وحوكمة الشركات (ESG) على رأس قائمة أولوياتها وذلك بهدف
تحقيق النموّ لأعمالنا بصورة تؤثّر إيجابياً في الأسواق والدوائر الاجتماعية التي نعمل على خدمتها على المدى
الطويل.

# At the heart of healthcare

Mediq serves healthcare professionals and patients with medical devices, healthcare products and
innovative solutions. We work with hospitals, healthcare facilities, GPs and nurses to ensure that
they can provide best possible care. We also supply people with the daily support and care they need
to successfully self-manage their chronic condition. Both in health-care settings and at home.

### Our Vision

## Enabling Sustainable Healthcare

At Mediq, we are at the heart of healthcare, supporting delivery to patients' homes, practitioners,
care institutions, and hospitals. We offer products, solutions, and services across major disease
areas, driving innovative solutions to address healthcare’s biggest challenges.

Fueled by our dedicated team, we optimize time and resources, making care more manageable for
providers, efficient for payors, better for the environment, and ultimately better for patients and
society. We call that Sustainable Care.

[Read more about us][18]

[care to care]
Our ESG Efforts

## We Care to Care

At Mediq, responsible and ethical business practices are at the heart of everything we do, guiding
our actions towards patients, employees, partners, suppliers, and investors. Mediq’s ESG
(Environmental, Social, Governance) strategy is built on four key pillars: products, services,
operations, and people. Our goal is to achieve carbon neutrality and create a lasting positive
impact on our environment and communities by 2050.

[Explore our full ESG strategy here][19]

## Providing empowerment, support and care

A lot has happened since Mediq was founded in the Netherlands in 1899 as a cooperative of
pharmacists. Our drive to help patients live higher quality lives is what has made our company the
leading European healthcare provider it is today. To this end, we consistently invest in operational
excellence as well as advanced digital technologies and innovative care delivery models. Always
looking for new opportunities to make life and work easier and more enjoyable for people with
healthcare needs and those who care for them.

[Read more about Mediq][20]

## Mediq is a major force in European Healthcare.

We have a strong presence across 14 countries. We support every patient, every healthcare
professional in all facets of healthcare in every country. The headquarter of Mediq is situated in
the Netherlands. If you wish to read more about Global Presence, you can follow the link below.

[Read more about Global Presence][25]

## Ready to shape tomorrow's healthcare?

At Mediq, you will be part of a diverse culture that puts people first: our own people and our
customers. An environment where you can grow professionally and personally. Where initiative is
encouraged and appreciated. So, if you are just as passionate about healthcare and want to help
shape its future to help patients, perhaps we should talk.

29 April 2026

#### Mediq launches Mediq Select: another step forward in enabling sustainable healthcare

Mediq offers a broad product portfolio, enabling healthcare professionals to choose what best fits
their needs—from trusted third-party brands to Mediq own-brand ranges. For years, our own brands,
including Klinion, Absorin, Curion and 365 Healthcare, have delivered a strong balance between high
quality standards and affordability.

To make this portfolio easier to navigate, Mediq is bringing these products together under a single
label: Mediq Select. While the products, specifications, and product codes remain unchanged, the new
label provides a clearer and more consistent way for healthcare professionals to identify solutions
they can trust.

customers.

serious diseases. Our ambitious and compassionate work has the potential to change lives.

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Important information about Calc4Lab, data privacy, and medical accuracy.

### Are my patients' data saved on your servers?

No. All calculations are performed locally within your browser. We do not store, track, or share any
personal health information (PHI), ensuring full privacy and compliance with healthcare data
standards.

### Can I rely on these calculators for a final medical diagnosis?

These tools are designed strictly as educational and supportive resources for healthcare
professionals. They do not replace comprehensive clinical judgment and should not be used as the
sole basis for diagnosis or treatment decisions.

### What are the sources of your medical formulas?

Our calculators are built upon peer-reviewed scientific literature and international medical
guidelines (such as AHA, KDIGO, and EASL). They are carefully curated and reviewed by medical
biology specialists.

### Is Calc4Lab completely free to use?

Yes, Calc4Lab is a completely free resource dedicated to supporting the global medical community,
researchers, and medical students.

## CODADA: Partner in Market Expansion

CODADA helps businesses in **FMCG, food and beverage, cosmetics, and personal care** to **find
importers**, **find distributors**, succeed with **market entry** and ongoing **distributor
management** in **Europe, Asia and the Middle East**. With over **20 years of experience**, we
provide **expert support** to grow your market presence and thrive in these **fast-growing
regions**.

#### Client-Centered Approach

CODADA starts with the client’s product, target channels, pricing structure, and market objectives.
This helps define a practical market entry route before approaching importers, distributors,
retailers, or other market partners. The result is a clearer starting point for market discussions
and partner selection.

#### In-Market Expertise

Our work combines experience in FMCG, food and beverage, cosmetics, personal care, and consumer
goods with practical market knowledge across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. This allows clients
to receive support that is commercially grounded and relevant to each market.

#### From Search to Follow-Up

The services include more than just finding importers or distributors. Our work covers market entry
preparation, partner qualification, communication, distributor management, market feedback, and
ongoing in-market support. This helps clients move from partner search to active market development.

#### Long-Term Development

CODADA helps clients build sustainable market presence through suitable partners, structured
follow-up, realistic market development, and long-term commercial progress. This helps turn early
market interest into practical next steps and ongoing business development.

compliance, ensuring success in new markets.

competitor activities. The focus is on delivering insights that support better decisions and
long-term planning. Research helps identify opportunities and guides businesses in finding importers
and distributors for effective market entry.

# About Dr Neil
# Gastroenterologist in Dubai

Dr. Neil is regarded as one of the leading experts in digestive health and the **best
Gastroenterologist in Dubai**.  He is a UK-trained senior Consultant in Gastroenterology and
Hepatology, with over 25 years of experience in investigating and treating GI and liver problems.

Dr Neil graduated with a BA Honours and an MA in Medical Sciences from Cambridge University and
obtained his medical MBBS degree with distinctions from the University of London.  He completed his
specialty training in Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Internal Medicine in a number of London’s top
teaching hospitals and was awarded with a CCT(UK) in Gastroenterology and General (Internal)
Medicine in 2007.  During his training he also spent three years in clinical and academic research
at Imperial College London.

EAST PHARMA sources, supplies, and distributes pharmaceutical products — branded, generic, and OTC —
for licensed European wholesale partners. GDP-compliant. Romania-based. Operating since 2018.

[**CONTACT US → **][15]

Who we are

## A Romanian partner for regulated pharmaceutical operations

We provide European pharmaceutical companies with direct access to the Romanian market through a
platform built on compliance, operational discipline, and commercial reliability.

Romania maintains some of the lowest regulated pharmaceutical prices in the EU, making it a
structurally relevant source market.

Authorized for pharmaceutical wholesale distribution in Romania and operating under EU GDP
standards, we support licensed partners across sourcing, supply, distribution, parallel export
coordination, and market execution. Our role is to provide a structured and dependable operating
route for pharmaceutical companies working in a regulated environment.

***02 Commercial coordination***
Structured local support for partners requiring reliable execution, communication, and coordination
in Romania.

***03 Regulatory coordination***
Careful handling of Romanian and EU documentation requirements across distribution-related
activities.

***04 Market entry support***
Practical guidance for pharmaceutical companies entering Romania, from initial engagement to
operational follow-through.

structure.

***03 Qualified B2B focus***
We work with licensed pharmaceutical companies and serious commercial partners across regulated
distribution activity.

follow-through.

# 24/7 Online Booking Available

[Book Now][195]

When searching for the best hospital in Dubai there are many factors to consider. For over two
decades Emirates Hospitals Group has been renowned for providing exceptional patient care. Our
surveys highlight eight key reasons why patients consistently choose Emirates Hospitals as their top
choice hospital in Dubai:

**1. Award Winning World-Class Doctors: **Our physicians are recruited globally, with many holding
Western Board Certifications or Fellowship Training from leading institutions in the USA, UK,

## About Us

Our journey began over 16 years ago with target discovery and mechanistic studies by our team’s
research efforts, followed by high-throughput screening and medicinal chemistry, culminating in
multiple classes of IKK inhibitors and our lead clinical candidate, HPN-01.

[Discover HPN-01 ][15]

### Addressing Unmet Needs in Liver Disease

### The Unmet Needs
* Chronic liver diseases such as MASH and inflammatory liver conditions affect millions worldwide,
  with limited effective therapies for patients with advanced fibrosis and inflammation.
   
* Current treatment options fail to adequately address disease progression and long-term outcomes.

[Hepanova for liver disease.gif]

### Our Science Approach
* Multi-Pathway Targeting
  Simultaneously addressing steatosis, inflammation, and fibrosis.
   
* Dual Impact
  Treats both MASH and its progression to HCC.
   
* Oral, Long-Acting Modality
  Convenient weekly dosing with strong safety and PK profile.

* Combination-Ready
  Designed for potential combination with GLP-1 agonists and other standards of care.

###### Introducing Our Lead Program

# HPN-01

HPN-01 is Hepanova’s lead clinical candidate and the only first-in-class, oral, highly selective
IKKα/β inhibitor designed for chronic liver disease and inflammation.

[Purple Gradient]

Advanced Fibrosis – Focused
MASH Program

### Targeting high-risk patients with limited treatment options

HPN-01 is designed for MASH patients with advanced fibrosis (F2–F4), addressing steatosis,
inflammation, and fibrosis through a differentiated, upstream mechanism.

Clinically Validated Phase 1
Completed

### Demonstrated safety and pharmacokinetics in humans

HPN-01 has completed a U.S. Phase 1 clinical trial, showing excellent safety and PK to support
long-term, chronic use.

Strong potential in IBD and
Inflammatory indications

### Broad anti-inflammatory potential beyond liver disease

HPN-01 has shown strong preclinical activity in IBD models, supporting development in both acute and
chronic inflammatory conditions.

[Purple gradient]

Efficient Multi-Indication
Development Strategy

### Leveraging cross-usable clinical and translational data

Future expansion is planned using shared Phase 1 data to enable rapid, capital-efficient advancement
into additional indications.

## HPN-01: Strategic Value in MASH

# Highly Validated Approaches to Highly Unmet Needs.

## Developing Treatments for Severe Liver Disease.

## about

Inipharm is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and developing
therapies for severe liver diseases. Inipharm's lead program is focused on the highly validated,
genetically-defined target, HSD17B13.

Inipharm, through its Australian subsidiary Inipharm Australia, Pty Ltd, is conducting a Phase 1
clinical trial, including MASH patients, of INI-822, a first in class small molecule inhibitor of
HSD17B13.

There is extensive, consistent evidence that genetic variants of HSD17B13 are associated with
significantly lower rates and severity of multiple liver diseases. Building on these novel insights
into the biologic activity of HSD17B13, Inipharm is advancing a pipeline of small-molecule therapies
that target the activity of this protein.

## clinical development

### First clinical-stage small molecule inhibitor of HSD17B13

Inipharm, through its Australian subsidiary Inipharm Australia, Pty Ltd, is conducting clinical
development of INI-822, the first small molecule HSD inhibitor. Phase 1 work in healthy volunteers
has been completed and testing in patients with MASH is underway. For more information:

#### Clinical pharmacokinetics of INI-822, a small molecule inhibitor of HSD17B13

[[Clinical pharmacokinetics of INI-822, a small molecule inhibitor of HSD17B13]Click here to
download PDF][7]

## our science

Inipharm is developing small-molecule inhibitors of HSD17B13 to treat fibrotic liver diseases.
Inipharm's inhibitors have been shown to drive alterations in lipid metabolism and improvements in
liver enzymes that are consistent with changes seen with the protective variant in humans. In human
liver cell-based systems, INI-822 demonstrated anti-fibrotic effects.

Protective variants in HSD17B13 are associated with reduced risk incidence and/or the severity of
numerous liver diseases.
* HSD17B13 has been identified as a novel target for NASH and driver of liver disease from a genome
  wide association study.
* Loss of function variants in HSD17B13 are associated with reduced risk incidence and/or the
  severity of numerous liver diseases.
* Importantly, HSD17B13 has been shown to be involved in pathways associated with lipotoxicity,
  inflammation, and fibrosis.

[HSD17B13 Disease Association Chart]SOURCES: Gellert-Kristensen 2019; Abul-Husn 2018; Kozlitina
2018; About 2018; Ferenci 2019, Yang 2020 Hepatol; About 2018 NEJM

### INI-822, development candidate
* Reduced fibrotic markers in human liver cell model
* Improved liver enzymes in multiple in vivo models
* Replicated lipidomic changes seen with protective HSD17B13 variant

# Highly Validated Approaches to Highly Unmet Needs.

## Developing Treatments for Severe Liver Disease.

## about

Inipharm is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and developing
therapies for severe liver diseases. Inipharm's lead program is focused on the highly validated,
genetically-defined target, HSD17B13.

Inipharm, through its Australian subsidiary Inipharm Australia, Pty Ltd, is conducting a Phase 1
clinical trial, including MASH patients, of INI-822, a first in class small molecule inhibitor of
HSD17B13.

There is extensive, consistent evidence that genetic variants of HSD17B13 are associated with
significantly lower rates and severity of multiple liver diseases. Building on these novel insights
into the biologic activity of HSD17B13, Inipharm is advancing a pipeline of small-molecule therapies
that target the activity of this protein.

## clinical development

### First clinical-stage small molecule inhibitor of HSD17B13

Inipharm, through its Australian subsidiary Inipharm Australia, Pty Ltd, is conducting clinical
development of INI-822, the first small molecule HSD inhibitor. Phase 1 work in healthy volunteers
has been completed and testing in patients with MASH is underway. For more information:

#### Clinical pharmacokinetics of INI-822, a small molecule inhibitor of HSD17B13

[[Clinical pharmacokinetics of INI-822, a small molecule inhibitor of HSD17B13]Click here to
download PDF][7]

## our science

Inipharm is developing small-molecule inhibitors of HSD17B13 to treat fibrotic liver diseases.
Inipharm's inhibitors have been shown to drive alterations in lipid metabolism and improvements in
liver enzymes that are consistent with changes seen with the protective variant in humans. In human
liver cell-based systems, INI-822 demonstrated anti-fibrotic effects.

Protective variants in HSD17B13 are associated with reduced risk incidence and/or the severity of
numerous liver diseases.
* HSD17B13 has been identified as a novel target for NASH and driver of liver disease from a genome
  wide association study.
* Loss of function variants in HSD17B13 are associated with reduced risk incidence and/or the
  severity of numerous liver diseases.
* Importantly, HSD17B13 has been shown to be involved in pathways associated with lipotoxicity,
  inflammation, and fibrosis.

2018; About 2018; Ferenci 2019, Yang 2020 Hepatol; About 2018 NEJM

### INI-822, development candidate
* Reduced fibrotic markers in human liver cell model
* Improved liver enzymes in multiple in vivo models
* Replicated lipidomic changes seen with protective HSD17B13 variant

Why Inspire

## Specialty supply is a clinical decision — we treat it that way.

Specialty medicines aren't ordinary stock. A delayed oncology cycle, a missed dialysis session, an
ICU drug that didn't make it through customs — each one shows up in patient outcomes.

Inspire was built to remove those failures from the supply side. We focus narrowly on four specialty
areas, we keep the same molecules in stock month after month, and we are accountable for the chain
from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

[More about Inspire][20]
What we do for clinicians and procurement

## Registered. Sourced. Delivered — to clinical specification.

We are organised around what hospital pharmacy, oncology day-care units, dialysis centres and tender
boards actually need: a known supplier, a registered product, and dependable lead time.

### Scientific office support

Our in-house medical team works directly with prescribers — protocol fit, mechanism of action,
contraindications and SmPC documentation. Specialty supply backed by clinical understanding, not
just a sales call.

### Cold-chain reliability

Biologics, plasma-derived therapies and selected oncology agents are handled with
temperature-controlled logistics, transit monitoring and conditioned warehousing — verified at
hospital goods-in.

### Hospital & tender supply

Direct supply to private & public hospitals, oncology day-care units, dialysis providers, and county
/ national pharmaceutical tenders.

[Full capabilities][21]
Built around the prescriber

## The people who choose the medicine are the people we work for.

Oncologists, nephrologists, hospital pharmacists, intensivists, procurement officers — these are the
audiences our scientific office, regulatory team and supply chain are designed around.

If you are one of them and you need product information, supply confirmation or a tender response,
our team is one enquiry away.

# Welcome to Jayan PharmaMed

### Contract Manufacturing

We are one of the leading third party manufacturers, suppliers and exporters of a variety of
Pharmaceutical Medicines like Tablets, Capsules, Syrups, Ointment & Injections, etc., which is
applicable to cure various diseases.

With a 20 year history distributing and manufacturing drugs, peaking with the manufacturing of 1000
million tablets, 200 million capsules, 50 million oral liquid and 10 million of beta lactam dry
syrups, dry injections, we projected that the manufacturing of drugs would move to the country
resulting in intense commodity price and profit deterioration.

Thus, we formed our branded and technology division and have directed most of our R&D budget towards
new branded product development since then. There are number of pharmaceutical companies which do
not have their own manufacturing unit, so that companies are associated with us for third party
pharma manufacturing services.

# Welcome to Jayan PharmaMed

### Contract Manufacturing

We are one of the leading third party manufacturers, suppliers and exporters of a variety of
Pharmaceutical Medicines like Tablets, Capsules, Syrups, Ointment & Injections, etc., which is
applicable to cure various diseases.

With a 20 year history distributing and manufacturing drugs, peaking with the manufacturing of 1000
million tablets, 200 million capsules, 50 million oral liquid and 10 million of beta lactam dry
syrups, dry injections, we projected that the manufacturing of drugs would move to the country
resulting in intense commodity price and profit deterioration.

Thus, we formed our branded and technology division and have directed most of our R&D budget towards
new branded product development since then. There are number of pharmaceutical companies which do
not have their own manufacturing unit, so that companies are associated with us for third party
pharma manufacturing services.

## Current Initiatives and Updates

American Liver Foundation provides current news and information on a variety of liver related topics
helping patients, friends and families affected by liver disease.
[

### American Liver Foundation Honors Congressman Jim Costa (D-CA) and Congressman Don Bacon (R-NE)
### with Congressional Champion Awards at its Liver Life Advocacy Summit in Washington, DC

][172]
American Liver Foundation’s (ALF) Liver Life Advocacy Summit was held in Washington, D.C. on April
21st and 22nd and brought together patients, caregivers and families from coast to coast to champion
legislative priorities for liver health and help the 100 million Americans affected by liver
disease.
[Learn More][173]
[

### ALF’s Official Charity Marathon Team Runs in 130th Annual Boston Marathon to Fight Liver Disease

][174]
American Liver Foundation (ALF) is proud to once again be a member of the 130th Boston Marathon®
presented by Bank of America, which takes place on Monday, April 20, 2026, at Hopkinton to Boston.
[Learn More][175]
[

### American Liver Foundation Elects David Frank as New Board Chair

][176]
American Liver Foundation (ALF) is excited to announce the election of David Frank as its new chair
of the board. David, who has served as Vice Chair of ALF’s board since March of 2025, is the Senior
Product Manager for Equities Cash & Derivatives at Wells Fargo Securities in NYC.
[Learn More][177]

# Find a Clinical Trial

Clinical trials are research studies that test how well new medical approaches work in people. Speak
with your doctor about the ongoing progress and results of these trials to get the most up-to-date
information on new treatments. Participating in a clinical trial is a great way to contribute to
curing, preventing, and treating liver disease and its complications. **[Start your search
here][178]** to find clinical trials that need people like you.

Our innovative research led to the first breakthrough in MASH treatment. And we’re just getting

Pam, patient advocate

[Jenn, living with MASH, gazes to the side and smiles gently.]

## Delivering a Breakthrough Treatment

Madrigal is a biopharmaceutical company focused on delivering novel therapeutics for metabolic
dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), a serious liver disease with high unmet medical need.
Left untreated, MASH can lead to progressive liver scarring, cirrhosis, liver failure, liver cancer,
need for transplant and premature mortality. Our goal is to halt or reverse liver scarring
(fibrosis) and resolve MASH before patients experience the devastating complications of cirrhosis.

Madrigal’s ambitious research program led to the first U.S. Food and Drug Administration
(FDA)-approved treatment in MASH.

[Our Medicine][26]

## Shining a Light on MASH

## Shining a Light on MASH

Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), formerly known as nonalcoholic
steatohepatitis (NASH), is a serious form of fatty liver disease that occurs when fat in the liver
becomes toxic, damaging liver cells. The chronic and progressive nature of the disease can cause
significant damage over time, including inflammation and scarring, or fibrosis. Fibrosis can
progress quickly and be unpredictable, often resulting in cirrhosis and decompensated liver disease.

MASH is the leading cause of liver transplantation in the U.S. for women and is expected to soon
become the leading cause for men.

## Steatohepatitis (MASH)

[Chronic Liver Stages]

## A Chronic Liver Disease

systems.

In MASH, reduced signaling via THR-β exacerbates hepatic mitochondrial dysfunction, inflammation,
and fibrosis.

Minapharm has made its mission to provide patients in developing countries with easy access to
innovative and high-quality medicines. Minapharm’s expertise encompasses a wide range of medicines,
from small molecules with advanced galenic formulation to more complex bioengineered proteins.

offers an impressive portfolio of proprietary technologies used by the global biotech industry at

## Helpful Information

The last thing you want is your time wasted with a confusing service, our [Knowledge Base][27] has
you covered. If you have any questions, reach out to our Customer Support Team via email:
[[email protected]][28]

#### [Are your CEU’s approved and accredited?][29]

Yes! Nursing CE Central is approved by ANCC and accepted by every Board of Nursing for every state;
ensuring that your contact hours and certificates are valid, regardless of your state(s) of
practice.

#### [Are tests required to complete CEU’s?][30]

No, Nursing CE Central does not require tests upon completing courses.* Simply read the material,
attest that you studied it, and receive your certificate instantly!

*The only instances of needing to take a test are for states that require it.

#### [What license levels do you offer?][31]

Nursing CE Central offers every course required to renew RN, LVN, and APRN licenses in every state.
However, your Incredible Health subscription only applies to RN and LVN level courses.

#### [What is included in enrollment?][32]

Your enrollment includes every course required for your CEU renewals, no matter what state you’re
in.

Your enrollment also includes valid certificates for every course you complete, and are sent to your
email and can be accessed 24/7 in your Nursing CE Central profile.

Yes! Nursing CE Central is approved by ANCC and accepted by every Board of Nursing for every state;
ensuring that your contact hours and certificates are valid, regardless of your state(s) of
practice.

#### [Are tests required to complete CEU’s?][30]

No, Nursing CE Central does not require tests upon completing courses.* Simply read the material,
attest that you studied it, and receive your certificate instantly!

*The only instances of needing to take a test are for states that require it.

#### [What license levels do you offer?][31]

Nursing CE Central offers every course required to renew RN, LVN, and APRN licenses in every state.
However, your Incredible Health subscription only applies to RN and LVN level courses.

#### [What is included in enrollment?][32]

Your enrollment includes every course required for your CEU renewals, no matter what state you’re
in.

Your enrollment also includes valid certificates for every course you complete, and are sent to your
email and can be accessed 24/7 in your Nursing CE Central profile.

#### [Are your courses available online?][33]

Yes! The courses are designed to provide maximal convenience and ease-of-use for nurses. You can
take courses on any device, anywhere, at any time.

#### [How do I complete my CE’s after paying?][34]

After you log in, you will be directed to the “Take Courses” page, with all courses available for
you to take at your convenience.

When you reach the end of a course, you will be prompted to click a green “Complete Course” button.
Upon clicking that button, you will be sent to a confirmation page, and your certificate will be
immediately sent to your email.

## Polypharma is your partner for a complete service in the production of generic drugs

## and supply of pharmaceutical raw material

 

**For 35 years**, Polypharma has been advising and supporting companies in **East, West and North
Africa** and the **Middle East** in the production of generic drugs.

We operate with existing companies or companies in construction. Thanks to our know-how, we advise
manufacturers wishing to expand their range of generics or investors looking for a partner who will
be able to guide them.

In addition, Polypharma assists its partners with dossier development, registrations, negotiations
with authorities and provides assistance on location.

[Please let us know your interest.][31]

## Our services at a glance
* [Dossier development][32]
* [Supply of pharmaceutical raw materials (APIs and excipients)][33]
* [Support in plant construction][34]
* [Advice in generics project planning][35]
* [Technical assistance for laboratory and validation batches][36]
* [Registration help][37]
* [Market-][38] and [feasibility studies][39]
* [Local service in Africa and the Middle East][40]

## Many years of experience in supporting generic drug manufacturers in Africa and the Middle East

## Product range of over 200 generic drug dossiers

Our product portfolio comprises more than 200 generic drug dossiers from the following areas:

* [Human medicine][41]
* [Veterinary medicine ][42]

## New molecules

In close cooperation with its partners and start-ups, **Polypharma is constantly looking for new
molecules** for the manufacture of:
* generics,
* food supplements and
* biosimilars

[Learn more by contacting us.][43]

## Support for investors in Africa and the Middle East in the production of generic drugs

In order to enable African and Middle Eastern countries to reduce imports of expensive (often
counterfeit) medicines, **Polypharma supports local entrepreneurs and investors in setting up their
own production facilities.**
**Our 360° service includes market analyses, feasibility studies, advice on the choice of a generic
product portfolio and production facilities.** We also guarantee the supply of pharmaceutical raw
materials.

[If you are interested please contact us.][44]

## Supply of pharmaceutical raw materials for Africa and the Middle East

Our raw materials are produced by internationally renowned manufacturers. We develop and use new
synthesis methods in order to be more competitive and ensure the best quality.

**We supply all the raw materials included in our dossiers, and many more, and advise you on
specific effects and pharmaceutical compositions. Depending on your requirements, we can adapt the
formulation of our technical dossiers by adapting the excipients.**

For more information, please click on the following link: [deliveries of pharmaceutical raw
materials][45]

Walter® Healthcare is one of India’s leading pharmaceutical CDMO / CMO. Backed by personnel with
over 25 years of expertise in the pharmaceutical industry, Walter's strategic business areas spread
across generics, APIs, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, custom pharmaceutical services, and branded
generics. The company is widely recognised for its strengths in manufacturing turn-around-time,
efficacy, service, and, new product additions, explorations in new therapeutic arenas, and
commercialisation of a wide range of products. Pharma Manufacturer, Pharma Company, Pharma PCD


Walter has 5 state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities strategically structured nationwide, approved
by stringent global regulatory authorities. Our own-brands portfolio includes 800 plus products
encompassing major therapeutic categories such as Cardiovascular, Neurology, Psychiatric, Hepatitis,
Gastroenterology, Respiratory & COPD, Rheumatology, Nephrology, Urology, Diabetes, Hepatology, and
Immunology, etc.


We’re not just another factory. We’re a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO)
built for speed, compliance, and scale. From oral solids and liquids to injectables and
nutraceuticals, we offer full-spectrum pharmaceutical manufacturing under one roof — backed by
GLP-certified labs, end-to-end quality systems, and audit-ready infrastructure.

 

Whether you’re a startup brand, a scaling MSME, or a public-listed pharma company looking for a
reliable CMO, Walter® is engineered to be your backend execution partner — not just a vendor.

 

 

## 🛠️ What We Offer

* WHO-GMP Certified Manufacturing Units
  
  For tablets, capsules, syrups, ointments, sachets, and injectables — fully licensed and
  export-compliant.
* GLP-Compliant In-House Laboratory (LabTrust™)
  
  Complete testing capabilities: ICH stability, endotoxins, microbial limits, preservative efficacy,
  and more.
* Aseptic Injectable & Nutraceutical Divisions
  
  With lyophilization, cleanroom tech, and specialized manufacturing lines — ensuring safety,
  sterility, and scalability.
* Walter® PlantSure™ Framework
  
  Our in-house quality philosophy that ensures every batch meets not just compliance, but
  consistency.
* 130,000+ sq. ft. Across 3 Facilities in Punjab & Himachal
  
  Built to handle high-volume demand with low MOQs, high agility, and 24/7 audit readiness.
* Turnkey Manufacturing Support
  
  Including formulation, packaging, licensing, testing, documentation, and dispatch — all under one
  point of contact.

 

 

## 🌐 Who We Work With

 
* Generic Pharma Companies (India & Emerging Markets)
* Public-Listed Mid-Sized Pharma Brands
* Distributors & Exporters (Semi-Regulated/Unregulated Countries)

* Government Supply Tenders (upon request)

 

 

## 🤝 Why Choose Walter®

 
* Low MOQs, fast turnarounds
* Radical transparency and accountability
* No overpromises — just high-performance execution
* Real photos, real infrastructure, real compliance

## **An AASLD Membership Pays Off at The Liver Meeting®** 

Save up to $935 on The Liver Meeting when you join or renew today and *ELEVATE* your experience as a
member this November in Denver, Colorado. From the AASLD Member Lounge, Members’ Reception at the
Denver Art Museum, and preferred rates at Headquarter hotels, becoming a member today makes a
difference for your arrival in November.  

[Activate My Savings][80]

### 2027 AASLD Committee & SIG Nominations

Whether you're looking to grow professionally, give back to our community, or expand your network,
this is your chance to strengthen AASLD and the future of liver health. Put your skills and
expertise to work in the volunteer role where you can make the greatest impact. 

[Peer-nominate or self-nominate by July 30.][81]

### Now Live: The Liver Meeting® 2026 Preliminary Guide

Start planning your TLM26 journey with this sneak peek program filled with registration rates,
highly anticipated sessions like the Postgraduate Course and Basic Science Symposium, and tips to
help you prepare for this year’s meeting. Inside, find all the critical details like hotels to stay
at in Denver, Colorado, registration opening dates, and when late-breaking abstract applications
will be accepted. And don’t forget, TLM26 will start on a Thursday this year, so start getting ready
today!  

[Access the Guide Now][82]

This investment fuels innovative research to advance the understanding, prevention, diagnosis, and
treatment of liver disease, while also expanding access to trained hepatology providers and
strengthening the global community of investigators working toward cures. 

[Learn more.][83]

# Innovative therapeutics that target
# serious viral and liver diseases

Assembly Bio is applying our passion, scientific ingenuity and deep knowledge of virology and liver
diseases to pursue novel therapies with the potential to change the paradigm for the treatment of
serious diseases. Our ambitious and compassionate work has the potential to change lives.

[Discover our pipeline][34]

## Frequently Asked Questions

Important information about Calc4Lab, data privacy, and medical accuracy.

### Are my patients' data saved on your servers?

No. All calculations are performed locally within your browser. We do not store, track, or share any
personal health information (PHI), ensuring full privacy and compliance with healthcare data
standards.

### Can I rely on these calculators for a final medical diagnosis?

These tools are designed strictly as educational and supportive resources for healthcare
professionals. They do not replace comprehensive clinical judgment and should not be used as the
sole basis for diagnosis or treatment decisions.

### What are the sources of your medical formulas?

Our calculators are built upon peer-reviewed scientific literature and international medical
guidelines (such as AHA, KDIGO, and EASL). They are carefully curated and reviewed by medical
biology specialists.

### Is Calc4Lab completely free to use?

Yes, Calc4Lab is a completely free resource dedicated to supporting the global medical community,
researchers, and medical students.

## CODADA: Partner in Market Expansion

CODADA helps businesses in **FMCG, food and beverage, cosmetics, and personal care** to **find
importers**, **find distributors**, succeed with **market entry** and ongoing **distributor
management** in **Europe, Asia and the Middle East**. With over **20 years of experience**, we
provide **expert support** to grow your market presence and thrive in these **fast-growing
regions**.

#### Client-Centered Approach

CODADA starts with the client’s product, target channels, pricing structure, and market objectives.
This helps define a practical market entry route before approaching importers, distributors,
retailers, or other market partners. The result is a clearer starting point for market discussions
and partner selection.

#### In-Market Expertise

Our work combines experience in FMCG, food and beverage, cosmetics, personal care, and consumer
goods with practical market knowledge across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. This allows clients
to receive support that is commercially grounded and relevant to each market.

#### From Search to Follow-Up

The services include more than just finding importers or distributors. Our work covers market entry
preparation, partner qualification, communication, distributor management, market feedback, and
ongoing in-market support. This helps clients move from partner search to active market development.

#### Long-Term Development

CODADA helps clients build sustainable market presence through suitable partners, structured
follow-up, realistic market development, and long-term commercial progress. This helps turn early
market interest into practical next steps and ongoing business development.

## Services

CODADA supports businesses with **market entry, distributor search, and ongoing distributor
management** across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.

We help companies **find distributors**, **identify importers**, and manage **local partnerships**
for sustainable growth in FMCG, F&B, cosmetics, personal care, and retail.

Our expertise includes guiding Western companies into Asian and Middle Eastern markets—through both
**B2B and B2C** channels.

We also support **Asian businesses expanding into Europe** and other international markets.

Each service is tailored to your needs, ensuring **smooth market entry** and **long-term success**.

#### [Market Entry][32]

CODADA supports structured market entry into Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. We help you find the
right partners, navigate compliance, and manage local follow-up - ensuring faster access and
long-term success across FMCG, food, beverage, cosmetics, personal care, and retail sectors.

brands, and companies in Asia and the Middle East on their behalf. Services include distributor
management, local promotions, and organizing trade events. This approach enhances visibility and
builds partnerships essential for sustainable growth.

Establishing a strong presence in local markets can be challenging. CODADA represents products,
brands, and companies in Asia and the Middle East on their behalf. Services include distributor
management, local promotions, and organizing trade events. This approach enhances visibility and
builds partnerships essential for sustainable growth.

#### [Distributor Management][34]

Working with the right distributors is critical for success. CODADA specializes in finding
distributors, building relationships, and managing performance. Support covers every stage, from
selection to long-term alignment with business goals. A well-managed distribution network ensures
efficient market coverage.

#### [Business Development][35]

Growth requires the right strategy and connections. Services focus on identifying new business
opportunities and building partnerships. Expertise in market entry and expansion ensures tailored
solutions for sustainable success. Support includes finding importers and distributors to strengthen
market presence.

#### [Import/Export Advisory][36]

Efficient import and export processes are essential for market entry. The team provides guidance on
regulations, licenses, certifications (e.g., Halal and FDA) and proper documentation. Every step is
designed to simplify trade operations. Businesses benefit from streamlined processes and full
compliance, ensuring success in new markets.

#### [Market Research, Insights & Reporting][37]

Understanding the market is key to growth. Services include analyzing trends, consumer behavior, and
competitor activities. The focus is on delivering insights that support better decisions and
long-term planning. Research helps identify opportunities and guides businesses in finding importers
and distributors for effective market entry.

## Why Us

CODADA supports FMCG, food, beverage, cosmetics, and personal care businesses with market entry and
distributor management.

With over 20 years of experience, we help companies achieve sustainable business growth.

Our team combines deep market knowledge across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.

# About Dr Neil
# Gastroenterologist in Dubai

Dr. Neil is regarded as one of the leading experts in digestive health and the **best
Gastroenterologist in Dubai**.  He is a UK-trained senior Consultant in Gastroenterology and
Hepatology, with over 25 years of experience in investigating and treating GI and liver problems.

Dr Neil graduated with a BA Honours and an MA in Medical Sciences from Cambridge University and
obtained his medical MBBS degree with distinctions from the University of London.  He completed his
specialty training in Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Internal Medicine in a number of London’s top
teaching hospitals and was awarded with a CCT(UK) in Gastroenterology and General (Internal)
Medicine in 2007.  During his training he also spent three years in clinical and academic research
at Imperial College London.

## [Romanian Pharmaceutical Wholesaler for Licensed EU Partners][14]

EAST PHARMA sources, supplies, and distributes pharmaceutical products — branded, generic, and OTC —
for licensed European wholesale partners. GDP-compliant. Romania-based. Operating since 2018.

[**CONTACT US → **][15]

Who we are

## A Romanian partner for regulated pharmaceutical operations

We provide European pharmaceutical companies with direct access to the Romanian market through a
platform built on compliance, operational discipline, and commercial reliability.

Romania maintains some of the lowest regulated pharmaceutical prices in the EU, making it a
structurally relevant source market.

Authorized for pharmaceutical wholesale distribution in Romania and operating under EU GDP
standards, we support licensed partners across sourcing, supply, distribution, parallel export
coordination, and market execution. Our role is to provide a structured and dependable operating
route for pharmaceutical companies working in a regulated environment.

[**ABOUT EAST PHARMA →**][16]

[
[GDP-compliant pharmaceutical distribution and coordination in Romania]
][17]

## What we support

***01 Supply and distribution****
*GDP-compliant sourcing, supply, and distribution of branded medicines, generics, and OTC products.

***02 Commercial coordination***
Structured local support for partners requiring reliable execution, communication, and coordination
in Romania.

***03 Regulatory coordination***
Careful handling of Romanian and EU documentation requirements across distribution-related
activities.

***04 Market entry support***
Practical guidance for pharmaceutical companies entering Romania, from initial engagement to
operational follow-through.

[
[Romanian pharmaceutical wholesaler supporting licensed EU partners]
][18]

## Why pharmaceutical partners choose EAST PHARMA

***01 GDP-based operating discipline***
We work through controlled processes shaped by EU GDP requirements and regulated wholesale practice.

***02 Romanian market execution***
We support sourcing, supply, distribution, and local coordination through a clear Romanian operating
structure.

***03 Qualified B2B focus***
We work with licensed pharmaceutical companies and serious commercial partners across regulated
distribution activity.

***04 Reliable long-term cooperation***
We build long-term relationships through clear communication, workable execution, and consistent
follow-through.

[**PARTNER WITH US →**][19]

[
[Romanian pharmaceutical partner for regulated B2B operations]
][20]

## Built for professional pharmaceutical partners

We work with licensed pharmaceutical companies seeking a capable and dependable Romanian partner.
Whether the need is pharmaceutical supply, local coordination, distribution execution, or regulated
market support, we provide a structured wholesale platform, clear documentation, and dependable
operational follow-through from the outset.

[**EXPLORE SERVICES →**][21]

## Looking for a Romanian pharmaceutical partner?

Tell us what you need, and our team will respond with the most appropriate next step.

** **[** GET IN TOUCH →**][22]

GDP-authorized pharmaceutical wholesale distributor

## [Romanian Pharmaceutical Wholesaler for Licensed EU Partners][14]

EAST PHARMA sources, supplies, and distributes pharmaceutical products — branded, generic, and OTC —
for licensed European wholesale partners. GDP-compliant. Romania-based. Operating since 2018.

[**CONTACT US → **][15]

Who we are

## A Romanian partner for regulated pharmaceutical operations

We provide European pharmaceutical companies with direct access to the Romanian market through a
platform built on compliance, operational discipline, and commercial reliability.

Romania maintains some of the lowest regulated pharmaceutical prices in the EU, making it a
structurally relevant source market.

Authorized for pharmaceutical wholesale distribution in Romania and operating under EU GDP
standards, we support licensed partners across sourcing, supply, distribution, parallel export
coordination, and market execution. Our role is to provide a structured and dependable operating
route for pharmaceutical companies working in a regulated environment.

[**ABOUT EAST PHARMA →**][16]

[
[GDP-compliant pharmaceutical distribution and coordination in Romania]

## What we support

***01 Supply and distribution****
*GDP-compliant sourcing, supply, and distribution of branded medicines, generics, and OTC products.

***02 Commercial coordination***
Structured local support for partners requiring reliable execution, communication, and coordination
in Romania.

***03 Regulatory coordination***
Careful handling of Romanian and EU documentation requirements across distribution-related
activities.

***04 Market entry support***
Practical guidance for pharmaceutical companies entering Romania, from initial engagement to
operational follow-through.

***01 GDP-based operating discipline***
We work through controlled processes shaped by EU GDP requirements and regulated wholesale practice.

***02 Romanian market execution***
We support sourcing, supply, distribution, and local coordination through a clear Romanian operating
structure.

***03 Qualified B2B focus***
We work with licensed pharmaceutical companies and serious commercial partners across regulated
distribution activity.

***04 Reliable long-term cooperation***
We build long-term relationships through clear communication, workable execution, and consistent
follow-through.

## About Us

Our journey began over 16 years ago with target discovery and mechanistic studies by our team’s
research efforts, followed by high-throughput screening and medicinal chemistry, culminating in
multiple classes of IKK inhibitors and our lead clinical candidate, HPN-01.

[Discover HPN-01 ][15]

### Addressing Unmet Needs in Liver Disease

### The Unmet Needs
* Chronic liver diseases such as MASH and inflammatory liver conditions affect millions worldwide,
  with limited effective therapies for patients with advanced fibrosis and inflammation.
   
* Current treatment options fail to adequately address disease progression and long-term outcomes.

[Hepanova for liver disease.gif]

### Our Science Approach
* Multi-Pathway Targeting
  Simultaneously addressing steatosis, inflammation, and fibrosis.
   
* Dual Impact
  Treats both MASH and its progression to HCC.
   
* Oral, Long-Acting Modality
  Convenient weekly dosing with strong safety and PK profile.

* Combination-Ready
  Designed for potential combination with GLP-1 agonists and other standards of care.

###### Introducing Our Lead Program

# HPN-01

HPN-01 is Hepanova’s lead clinical candidate and the only first-in-class, oral, highly selective
IKKα/β inhibitor designed for chronic liver disease and inflammation.

[Purple Gradient]

Advanced Fibrosis – Focused
MASH Program

### Targeting high-risk patients with limited treatment options

HPN-01 is designed for MASH patients with advanced fibrosis (F2–F4), addressing steatosis,
inflammation, and fibrosis through a differentiated, upstream mechanism.

Clinically Validated Phase 1
Completed

### Demonstrated safety and pharmacokinetics in humans

HPN-01 has completed a U.S. Phase 1 clinical trial, showing excellent safety and PK to support
long-term, chronic use.

Strong potential in IBD and
Inflammatory indications

### Broad anti-inflammatory potential beyond liver disease

HPN-01 has shown strong preclinical activity in IBD models, supporting development in both acute and
chronic inflammatory conditions.

[Purple gradient]

Efficient Multi-Indication
Development Strategy

### Leveraging cross-usable clinical and translational data

Future expansion is planned using shared Phase 1 data to enable rapid, capital-efficient advancement
into additional indications.

  * NF-κB signaling is a central driver of both acute inflammation and chronic immune dysregulation

    drivers.
  * This mirrors the same upstream control logic applied in MASH.

  * Expands partnering and commercial optionality in a multi-billion-dollar IBD market.

## Technology Platform

Hepanova’s technology platform, rooted in decades of NIH- and Harvard-derived research, enables the
efficient creation of first-in-class therapies for chronic liver and inflammatory diseases by

## Flagship First-in-Class Pipeline (HPN-01 Series)

The HPN-01 series represents a novel class of oral, long-acting small molecules targeting upstream
inflammatory and fibrotic drivers. With broad anti-inflammatory and anti-fibrotic activity, the
program is positioned across MASH, liver fibrosis, IBD, and related indications, serving as clinical
validation of the platform.

## First-in-Class Drug Design Platform

Hepanova’s medicinal chemistry engine is designed to tackle historically challenging targets and
generate differentiated chemical matter. The platform combines proprietary compound libraries,
large-scale screening, and PK/PD-driven optimization to create long-acting, tissue-selective oral
molecules suitable for chronic use.

[Lab Testing Equipment]

Hepanova’s repeatable platform continuously generates new discovery and preclinical programs,
enabling pipeline expansion, combination strategies, and strategic partnerships beyond any single
product.

early clinical proof of concept. Expertise in Phase 1 safety, pharmacokinetics, and multi-indication
development enables efficient scaling across programs sharing common biology.

# Highly Validated Approaches to Highly Unmet Needs.

## Developing Treatments for Severe Liver Disease.

## about

Inipharm is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and developing
therapies for severe liver diseases. Inipharm's lead program is focused on the highly validated,
genetically-defined target, HSD17B13.

Inipharm, through its Australian subsidiary Inipharm Australia, Pty Ltd, is conducting a Phase 1
clinical trial, including MASH patients, of INI-822, a first in class small molecule inhibitor of
HSD17B13.

There is extensive, consistent evidence that genetic variants of HSD17B13 are associated with
significantly lower rates and severity of multiple liver diseases. Building on these novel insights
into the biologic activity of HSD17B13, Inipharm is advancing a pipeline of small-molecule therapies
that target the activity of this protein.

## clinical development

### First clinical-stage small molecule inhibitor of HSD17B13

Inipharm, through its Australian subsidiary Inipharm Australia, Pty Ltd, is conducting clinical
development of INI-822, the first small molecule HSD inhibitor. Phase 1 work in healthy volunteers
has been completed and testing in patients with MASH is underway. For more information:

#### Clinical pharmacokinetics of INI-822, a small molecule inhibitor of HSD17B13

[[Clinical pharmacokinetics of INI-822, a small molecule inhibitor of HSD17B13]Click here to
download PDF][7]

## our science

Inipharm is developing small-molecule inhibitors of HSD17B13 to treat fibrotic liver diseases.
Inipharm's inhibitors have been shown to drive alterations in lipid metabolism and improvements in
liver enzymes that are consistent with changes seen with the protective variant in humans. In human
liver cell-based systems, INI-822 demonstrated anti-fibrotic effects.

Protective variants in HSD17B13 are associated with reduced risk incidence and/or the severity of
numerous liver diseases.
* HSD17B13 has been identified as a novel target for NASH and driver of liver disease from a genome
  wide association study.
* Loss of function variants in HSD17B13 are associated with reduced risk incidence and/or the
  severity of numerous liver diseases.
* Importantly, HSD17B13 has been shown to be involved in pathways associated with lipotoxicity,
  inflammation, and fibrosis.

[HSD17B13 Disease Association Chart]SOURCES: Gellert-Kristensen 2019; Abul-Husn 2018; Kozlitina
2018; About 2018; Ferenci 2019, Yang 2020 Hepatol; About 2018 NEJM

### INI-822, development candidate
* Reduced fibrotic markers in human liver cell model
* Improved liver enzymes in multiple in vivo models
* Replicated lipidomic changes seen with protective HSD17B13 variant

[[HSD17B13 Disease Association Chart]Click here to download PDF][8]

#### Inhibition of HSD17B13 by the small molecule inhibitor, INI-822, increases liver
#### phosphatidylcholines in a diet-dependent manner

[[Inhibition of HSD17B13 by the small molecule inhibitor, INI-822, increases liver
phosphatidylcholines in a diet-dependent manner]Click here to download PDF][9]

Why Inspire

## Specialty supply is a clinical decision — we treat it that way.

Specialty medicines aren't ordinary stock. A delayed oncology cycle, a missed dialysis session, an
ICU drug that didn't make it through customs — each one shows up in patient outcomes.

Inspire was built to remove those failures from the supply side. We focus narrowly on four specialty

**Nishele**, Living with Serious Liver Disease

### Company News

Read our latest press releases[Click Here][23]

# Building a healthier tomorrow

At Intercept, our focus is to develop and deliver novel medicines for those living with rare liver
diseases.

[See Our Focus][24]

## Innovating to solve some of today’s toughest medical challenges

Using key discoveries in the field of liver health, we’re advancing treatments for rare and serious
liver diseases. Our portfolio is based on novel scientific targets with the potential for
therapeutic application across multiple liver diseases.

[Women]

## Working to improve the lives of people with serious liver diseases

Intercept Pharmaceuticals is committed to transforming the future for people with serious liver
diseases. We are trailblazers, driven by a passion to stand by patients who deserve more hope and
better solutions.

“

## When you have a rare chronic illness,
## it is really important to understand what you need to do to manage it.
## As a mom, it can be hard for me to
## put my own health needs first, but I know that I have to.”

[Read Ally's Story][25]

[Ally]

**Ally**, Living with Serious Liver Disease

[Woman on Pier]

## Resources, connection and support for patients

We’ve gathered community resources for education, connection and support for people living with
liver diseases, caregivers, family members and those interested in learning more.

[Explore Patient Resources][26]
* ## Research focused on liver diseases with high unmet need
  
  Our research is based on novel scientific targets with the potential for therapeutic application
  across multiple liver diseases.
  
  [View Pipeline][27]
* ## Biology in pursuit of better health
  
  Farnesoid X Receptor (FXR) biology is at the core of our therapeutic research. This treatment
  modality has applications for severe liver conditions such as severe alcohol-associated hepatitis.
  
  [Read more about our platform][28]

[Man Using Computer]

## About Us

Since 2002, we’ve pioneered a novel scientific platform to answer critical needs in the liver health
community and deliver on our mission to build a healthier tomorrow for people with rare and serious
liver diseases.

[Woman][About Us][29]
[Leadership Team][Leadership][30]

## Working at Intercept

Intercept Pharmaceuticals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Alfasigma, is part of a rapidly expanding
global biopharmaceutical leader with a presence in over 100 countries. Our mission is rooted in
advancing innovative therapies for people living with serious liver diseases, and our team is
dedicated to bringing hope to those whose health journeys demand new solutions.

[Help]

If you thrive on curiosity, value diverse perspectives, embrace bold thinking, and are
passionate about creating life-changing solutions, you belong here—where innovation
drives everything we do.

## ABOUT KMK

KMK CHEMICALS is a leading distributor and an ISO certified company specialized in sourcing and
distributing Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients and Finished Formulations in MENA region, Being a
customer-oriented company, we continuously enlarge our portfolio to be able to offer smart solutions
and to meet most of the requirements of our customers in an easy way. Our team always share their
technical and business insights to our customers for their new and existing products. Knowing the
importance of our suppliers as well, KMK uses advanced ways to facilitate business transactions with
them. We developed our digital channel (KMK Mobile Application) to be able to serve our wide-ranging
networks of suppliers and customers in a smart way.

### Our Mission

Excellence and prevalence in submitting company and customer service’s considering our code of
ethics. Excellence and superiority in professional development and in applying information
technology with the use of capital manpower. Excellence and efficiency in developing the raw
materials industry and in health activities participation that serves the community in the MENA
region.

### Our Vision

KMK’s vision is to empower Pharmaceutical companies by being one of the top five distributors of
Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients and Pharmaceutical Finished formulations in the MENA region . Our
objective is to be perceived as the first choice for our customers when it comes to API & FDF
sourcing.

### Our Values

- Excellence

- Performance

- Integrity

- Accountability

- Market Oriented

### American Liver Foundation Honors Congressman Jim Costa (D-CA) and Congressman Don Bacon (R-NE)
### with Congressional Champion Awards at its Liver Life Advocacy Summit in Washington, DC

][172]
American Liver Foundation’s (ALF) Liver Life Advocacy Summit was held in Washington, D.C. on April
21st and 22nd and brought together patients, caregivers and families from coast to coast to champion
legislative priorities for liver health and help the 100 million Americans affected by liver
disease.

presented by Bank of America, which takes place on Monday, April 20, 2026, at Hopkinton to Boston.
[Learn More][175]

### American Liver Foundation Elects David Frank as New Board Chair

][176]
American Liver Foundation (ALF) is excited to announce the election of David Frank as its new chair
of the board. David, who has served as Vice Chair of ALF’s board since March of 2025, is the Senior
Product Manager for Equities Cash & Derivatives at Wells Fargo Securities in NYC.
[Learn More][177]

# Find a Clinical Trial

Clinical trials are research studies that test how well new medical approaches work in people. Speak
with your doctor about the ongoing progress and results of these trials to get the most up-to-date
information on new treatments. Participating in a clinical trial is a great way to contribute to
curing, preventing, and treating liver disease and its complications. **[Start your search
here][178]** to find clinical trials that need people like you.

Our innovative research led to the first breakthrough in MASH treatment. And we’re just getting

[More About Madrigal][24]
[Close]

[European Commission Grants Approval of Our Medicine. Read more][25]

Pam, patient advocate

[Jenn, living with MASH, gazes to the side and smiles gently.]

## Delivering a Breakthrough Treatment

Madrigal is a biopharmaceutical company focused on delivering novel therapeutics for metabolic
dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), a serious liver disease with high unmet medical need.
Left untreated, MASH can lead to progressive liver scarring, cirrhosis, liver failure, liver cancer,
need for transplant and premature mortality. Our goal is to halt or reverse liver scarring
(fibrosis) and resolve MASH before patients experience the devastating complications of cirrhosis.

Madrigal’s ambitious research program led to the first U.S. Food and Drug Administration
(FDA)-approved treatment in MASH.

[Our Medicine][26]

## Shining a Light on MASH

## Shining a Light on MASH

Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), formerly known as nonalcoholic
steatohepatitis (NASH), is a serious form of fatty liver disease that occurs when fat in the liver
becomes toxic, damaging liver cells. The chronic and progressive nature of the disease can cause
significant damage over time, including inflammation and scarring, or fibrosis. Fibrosis can
progress quickly and be unpredictable, often resulting in cirrhosis and decompensated liver disease.

MASH is the leading cause of liver transplantation in the U.S. for women and is expected to soon
become the leading cause for men.

[More About MASH][27]

innovative and high-quality medicines. Minapharm’s expertise encompasses a wide range of medicines,

offers an impressive portfolio of proprietary technologies used by the global biotech industry at

## Helpful Information

The last thing you want is your time wasted with a confusing service, our [Knowledge Base][27] has
you covered. If you have any questions, reach out to our Customer Support Team via email:
[[email protected]][28]

#### [Are your CEU’s approved and accredited?][29]

Yes! Nursing CE Central is approved by ANCC and accepted by every Board of Nursing for every state;
ensuring that your contact hours and certificates are valid, regardless of your state(s) of
practice.

#### [Are tests required to complete CEU’s?][30]

No, Nursing CE Central does not require tests upon completing courses.* Simply read the material,
attest that you studied it, and receive your certificate instantly!

*The only instances of needing to take a test are for states that require it.

#### [What license levels do you offer?][31]

Nursing CE Central offers every course required to renew RN, LVN, and APRN licenses in every state.
However, your Incredible Health subscription only applies to RN and LVN level courses.

#### [What is included in enrollment?][32]

Your enrollment includes every course required for your CEU renewals, no matter what state you’re
in.

Your enrollment also includes valid certificates for every course you complete, and are sent to your
email and can be accessed 24/7 in your Nursing CE Central profile.

#### [Are your courses available online?][33]

Yes! The courses are designed to provide maximal convenience and ease-of-use for nurses. You can
take courses on any device, anywhere, at any time.

#### [How do I complete my CE’s after paying?][34]

After you log in, you will be directed to the “Take Courses” page, with all courses available for
you to take at your convenience.

When you reach the end of a course, you will be prompted to click a green “Complete Course” button.
Upon clicking that button, you will be sent to a confirmation page, and your certificate will be
immediately sent to your email.

## Polypharma is your partner for a complete service in the production of generic drugs

## and supply of pharmaceutical raw material

 

**For 35 years**, Polypharma has been advising and supporting companies in **East, West and North
Africa** and the **Middle East** in the production of generic drugs.

We operate with existing companies or companies in construction. Thanks to our know-how, we advise
manufacturers wishing to expand their range of generics or investors looking for a partner who will
be able to guide them.

In addition, Polypharma assists its partners with dossier development, registrations, negotiations
with authorities and provides assistance on location.

[Please let us know your interest.][31]

## Our services at a glance
* [Dossier development][32]
* [Supply of pharmaceutical raw materials (APIs and excipients)][33]
* [Support in plant construction][34]
* [Advice in generics project planning][35]
